summary: OR Royalties Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing preliminary Q2 2026 gold-equivalent ounce deliveries of 20,757 GEOs, preliminary revenues of $97.8M, and a cash margin of ~$94.7M (96.8%). It also disclosed a cash position of $75.6M after $8.0M in share repurchases under its normal course issuer bid, a drawn credit facility of $215.0M with $435.0M available, and net debt of $139.4M. The press release notes a pending $9.0M Murray Brook precious metals stream transaction with Canadian Copper Inc. expected to close in Q3 2026. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation M&A, activism, or structural change; the share repurchases are ordinary-course. What to watch: Q2 full results on August 5, 2026.
